local energy that's hard to find in bigger Florida cities.

opening on Friday night, grab a craft beer at Intracoastal 
Brewing on Saturday afternoon, and kayak the lagoon on Sunday 
morning — all without ever getting in a car.

Melbourne as a whole sits at the heart of the Space Coast, 
offering something rare: beach town beauty without the tourist 
trap prices. You're 30 minutes from Kennedy Space Center

  scenic river paths. Local bike rentals are available nearby.
